messages.text: Base, do you copy? The external lights just flickered.
We copy, Alpha. Pressure readings are stable. What do you see?
There's something... massive moving outside the viewport.
Impossible. Nothing that size lives down there.
It just blinked. Base, it has an eye the size of the submersible.
Alpha, surface NOW. That's an order.
It's too late. It's following the cable up.
